title: RecoveryPlan
description: The compensating action for a side effect that failed or must be reversible, per .claude/rules/side-effects-recovery.md ('a failed or partial side effect cannot be repaired by source rollback alone'). Consumer: ops.mjs recovery-plan add, linked from side-effect-record.recoveryPlanId; required before completion-gate.mjs will pass a mission containing an unreconciled DESTRUCTIVE/EXTERNAL_WRITE effect.
